messages.subject: Re: xlsx Hide Worksheet
parts:
Hi Eleanor, 

In the future, please send emails to the group and not to me directly. 

Once you have a workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()
you can do
wb$setSheetHidden(0L, 1L) if you want to hide the first sheet (0-based indexing in Java)
See the documentation here

http://poi.apache.org/apidocs/org/apache/poi/xssf/usermodel/XSSFWorkbook.html#setSheetHidden(int, int)

Best regards, 
Adrian
